extracted.intended_audience: researchers, institutional leaders, funders, and infrastructure providers (stakeholders in Open Science and repository managers)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and service-oriented standards for making research outputs FAIR, interoperable with EOSC/OpenAIRE, privacy-preserving, and discoverable across repositories, data sources, and publishing workflows. Targets repository managers, research offices, funders, and infrastructure providers implementing open-science practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Repository meets OpenAIRE and EOSC interoperability standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure your repository or data source meets OpenAIRE and EOSC interoperability standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page repeats this requirement as a core service: repositories/data sources should implement interoperability features defined by OpenAIRE/EOSC. Implies use of compatible metadata standards, APIs and protocols to be harvestable and integrated into the OpenAIRE Graph and EOSC federation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aggregate and interconnect content with EOSC-compliant metadata
rubrics_metrics.description: Aggregate and interconnect content from repositories, CRIS systems, and journals with EOSC-compliant metadata.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Repositories and systems should expose EOSC-compliant metadata to enable aggregation and interlinking across publications, data, software, and projects. This supports building a rich, interlinked graph of research outputs for discovery and analytics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create FAIR, machine-actionable Data and Software Management Plans
rubrics_metrics.description: Create FAIR, machine-actionable Data and Software Management Plans that evolve with your project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: DMPs should follow FAIR principles and be machine-actionable (structured, interoperable) so they can be updated across the project lifecycle and integrated with services/tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Share and preserve outputs with a trusted, FAIR-aligned repository
rubrics_metrics.description: Share and preserve research outputs of any kind with a trusted, FAIR-aligned repository powered by CERN.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use repositories that implement FAIR principles for long-term preservation, discoverability and reuse. Trust and infrastructure provenance (e.g., CERN-powered) are highlighted as quality indicators.

rubrics_metrics.name: Anonymise research data while preserving utility
rubrics_metrics.description: An easy-to-use tool to anonymize research data and protect privacy while preserving utility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: OpenAIRE/Amnesia provides functionality for anonymising medical imaging and other sensitive data, emphasizing privacy-preserving data sharing in health research. Criterion implies ability to remove/transform identifiers while retaining analytical value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support privacy-preserving, secure health data sharing
rubrics_metrics.description: Support secure and privacy-preserving data sharing in health research (e.g., anonymising medical imaging data).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Services should enable compliant, secure sharing workflows for sensitive health data, including anonymisation capabilities and tools that expand support for privacy-preserving methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disambiguate and map organisations with trusted identifiers
rubrics_metrics.description: Disambiguate and map research-performing organizations across data sources with trusted identifiers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use and expose persistent, trusted identifiers (e.g., ROR) to ensure accurate linking and aggregation of organizational affiliations across repositories and systems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Track and compare standardized usage metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Track and compare standardized usage metrics (views and downloads) across repositories and journals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implement standardized metrics collection and reporting so usage (views/downloads) can be compared across sites; supports monitoring and analytics for impact assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discover links between datasets and publications via Scholix
rubrics_metrics.description: Discover links between datasets and publications worldwide through an open, global Scholix index.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expose and consume Scholix-compliant links to make relationships between datasets and literature explicit and discoverable in aggregated services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Run overlay journals connecting preprints and peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: Run overlay journals that peer review preprints and connect seamlessly to the open publishing ecosystem.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports models where peer review and publishing are layered on preprint servers—requires workflows and metadata to link review records, versions, and preprints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Build narrative CV and Open Science profiles
rubrics_metrics.description: Build your narrative CV and Open Science profile to highlight contributions beyond publications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Services should allow researchers to curate profiles that showcase datasets, software, peer review contributions, and other non-traditional outputs, supporting broader assessment of contributions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Track research trends and provide real-time analytics
rubrics_metrics.description: Track research trends, assess impact, and align practices with real-time analytics across funders, institutions, and disciplines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offer analytics tools that aggregate standardized metadata and metrics to inform policy, assessment, and strategic decisions across stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advance Responsible Research Assessment aligned with CoARA
rubrics_metrics.description: Advance Responsible Research Assessment aligned with CoARA (Coalition for Advancing Research Assessment).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Promote assessment practices that align with CoARA principles—moving towards qualitative, inclusive evaluation rather than narrow metrics; implies tooling and policy support for reform.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide EOSC Interoperability Backbone services
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide EOSC Interoperability Backbone for EOSC EU Node and Federation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operate or integrate with core interoperability infrastructure components that enable EOSC federation functions (discovery, metadata exchange, identity/disambiguation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrate diverse outputs into a linked OpenAIRE Graph
rubrics_metrics.description: Uncover the full picture of global research with a rich, interlinked graph of publications, data, software, projects and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contribute interoperable metadata to the OpenAIRE Graph to ensure outputs are linked, discoverable and usable for scientometrics and reuse; supports building a single, integrated view of research.
